unit.why: The division holds a quoted tale about the Neskhizer and the sons of the Zlotshover Maggid scraping gold from their father's table, then the author's own oral report that the Neskhizer revived a dead person with the Maggid's tea cup.

stories.start_quote: כאשר נשמע בעולם פרסום מופתי הנעסכיזר
stories.summary_en: The five sons of the Maggid of Zlotshov gather to examine whether the Neskhizer's wonders are suspect; the Neskhizer senses it through the holy spirit, comes there, wins their recognition, and scrapes gold from their father's table before their eyes.

tags.why: He knows of the gathering through the holy spirit.

quotes: ויקח סכין ויגרוד זהב מהשלחן לעיניהם
tags.why: He scrapes gold from a wooden table.

quotes: להתבונן אודות הנעסכיזר ומהות נפלאותיו אם יש לחוש ח״ו לזה
tags.why: Other tsaddikim scrutinize a rival wonder-worker.

quotes: ויראו כי קדוש הוא והכירו בו ויחבבוהו כראוי
tags.why: The suspicious sons come to recognize his holiness.
Doubters are won over by the events.

quotes: וישמעו מזה בני רבו המגיד מזלאטשוב
tags.why: The sons of the Maggid of Zlotshov act in the story.

quotes: אילו הי׳ אצלי שולחן רבי אביכם זצוקללה"ה הייתי גורד זהב ממנו
tags.why: The master's sanctified table holds power.

quotes: וכל באי עולם חרדו מעזוזי נפלאותיו
tags.why: People are in awe of his wonders.

missing_concepts: sanctity of objects belonging to a tsaddik (relics)
testing or vetting the legitimacy of a wonder-worker

stories.start_quote: אני הכותם שמעתי מאיש מהימן מאוד
stories.summary_en: The author reports, through a chain of trusted tellers, that R. Mordecai of Neskhiz revived a dead person using the vessel from which his master, the Maggid of Zlotshov, drank tea.

quotes: שהחי׳ את המת בהכלי ששתה בו טייא

tags.why: A death is implied before the revival.

quotes: בהכלי ששתה בו טייא רבו רבינו הקדוש המגיד
tags.why: The master's vessel carries his power.
The disciple uses his master's object.

quotes: ששמע בעצמו מזקינו הגה״ק הנ"ל שאמר בשם
tags.why: The tale is framed by a chain of oral transmission from tsaddikim.

missing_concepts: relics / holy objects of a tsaddik
